question: In which of the following years was Wipro Ltd incorporated ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1945 **__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The founder of WIPRO is **Azim Premji**.
 
• It was incorporated on **29 December 1945**.
 
• The **headquarters** of WIPRO is in **Bengaluru, India**.
 
• **Abidali Neemuchwala** is the current **CEO of WIPRO**.
